contract:
Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::createProductCatalog(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	precondition:
		ProductCatalog.allInstances()->forAll(pc: ProductCatalog|pc.Id<>id)
	postcondition:
		let productCatalog: ProductCatalog in
		productCatalog.oclIsNew() and
		ProductCatalog.allInstances()->includes(productCatalog) and
		productCatalog.Id = id and
		productCatalog.Name = name and
		result = true
}
